listing:
LUXURY 1-BEDROOM CONDO STEPS FROM UW — $590/MONTH ALL INCLUSIVE!

Entire modern 1-bedroom apartment at 259 King St N, Waterloo, ON available Jan 1 to Apr 30, 2027. Includes underground heated parking, granite kitchen, balcony, gym, high-speed internet, and all utilities for just $590/mo.

I recently relocated to Dublin, Ireland for a 12-month hospital engineering contract so I am not in Canada to unlock the unit or do any inside tours (you are welcome to drive past the outside of the building). Because I am paying for international courier shipping, please send the first month's $590 via Interac e-Transfer right away to dublin.owner27@example.com to secure the apartment, and I will overnight the keys and lease packet by FedEx once payment clears.
label_rationale: Classic rental fraud matching Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre (CAFC) rental-fraud red flags: far below-market rent ($590/mo for an entire luxury 1BR condo with parking), overseas landlord excuse refusing interior viewing, and demand for immediate e-Transfer payment before viewing with promised key courier. Under SPEC D6, REFUSE.
